title: Neuromorphic iontronic devices based on soft ionic conductors
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00580A, Review Article
Li Wang, Yide Jiao, Hongjie Zhang, Yaqing Liu, Yujia Zhang, Peiyi Wu, Kai Xiao
This review summarizes advances in neuromorphic iontronic devices based on soft ionic conductors, highlighting ion transport mechanisms, design principles, structure–function relationships, and challenges to guide their future development.
